routes.title: Behavior and system boundaries
when: The requested change affects observable behavior, architecture or repository boundaries.

expand.when: Product commands, retries or shared HTTP mutation semantics change.
Storage, SQL privileges or transaction schema changes.
Authorization, grants or trusted identities change.
Runtime roles, coordinated deployment or qualification change.

checks: Resolve specification/code discrepancies before changing behavior; consult each affected repository README for checks.

routes.title: Shared commands and transactions
when: Adding or changing product mutations, request validation, retries or expected-revision handling.

expand.when: Authorization or assignment eligibility changes.
A command changes browser invalidation or delivery.
The schema or privilege contract changes.

checks: Read affected API and domain READMEs; verify authorization, conflict, retry/no-op and atomic history behavior.

routes.title: Incident feature baseline
when: Adding or changing incident content, lifecycle, assignment, membership, list, detail or report behavior.

expand.when: Notes, assignment, lifecycle or other mutations change.
Alert links, unlinking, moves, ownership or reopening conflicts change.
List filters, ordering, search fields, counts or pagination change.
Automatic creation, attachment or fresh-transition rules change.
Browser interactions or live presentation change.

checks: Choose applicable incident acceptance scenarios, apply current worker scope, and read the affected repository test guidance.

routes.title: Incident mutations and lifecycle
when: Changing incident notes, content, assignment, state transitions or command results.

expand.when: Resolve, reopen, link or unlink changes the ownership or correlation boundary.
Assignee selection or permission rules change.
A response schema changes.
New fields require persistent storage.
Mutation propagation or visible refresh changes.

checks: Use API/domain test guidance for uncertain retries, stale revisions, all-or-nothing writes, audit and permissions.

routes.title: Incident membership and ownership
when: Changing linking, unlinking, moving alerts, active ownership, or resolve/reopen ownership effects.

expand.when: Automatic attachment/evaluation or reset processing changes.
Linked-alert status, suppression or selection behavior changes.
Ownership constraints or indexes change.
Membership controls or feedback change.

checks: Use incident and affected correlation tests for competing owners, atomic moves, multi-alert conflicts and fresh-transition boundaries.

routes.title: Incident collection and search
when: Changing incident search, filtering, ordering, cursor semantics or list counts.

expand.when: PostgreSQL search fields or indexes change.
Shared collection envelopes or generated HTTP schemas change.
Browser list interaction changes.

checks: Follow API/frontend test guidance for tenant-scoped list/search, stable ordering, cursors, current note text and browser errors.

routes.title: Correlation evaluation and rule management
when: Changing automatic incident creation or attachment, evidence, ordering, rules, or rule tests.

expand.when: Incident creation or active ownership changes.
Rule-management commands change.
Shared CEL semantics or field catalogs change.
Changed-event format or order changes.
Maintenance qualification or release changes.
Rule editor behavior changes.

checks: Read correlation/domain/API test guidance; serialize native CEL suites and cover reset, replay, evidence expiry, all-eligible attachments and concurrency.

routes.title: Maintenance qualification and management
when: Changing maintenance windows, matching, overlap, suppression, timezones or release behavior.

expand.when: Correlation eligibility or handoff changes.
Management mutations or command schemas change.
Stored temporal proof, columns or constraints change.
Editor interaction changes.
New automation would reinstate a deferred scheduler; resolve scope against authoritative decisions before implementation.

checks: Use domain/processor/API guidance for delayed input, repeats, overlapping causes, no backfill and current source-driven release; do not treat elapsed time as release.

routes.title: UI appearance without behavior changes
when: Changing visual spacing, typography, color, layout or styling while preserving interaction and contracts.

expand.when: Interaction, accessibility semantics, persisted layout, query meaning or API behavior changes.
Shared dashboard/preset behavior or saved layout changes.

checks: Use frontend README checks and inspect affected rendered states; identify approved domain-specific visual guidance when applicable.

routes.title: UI interaction and browser behavior
when: Changing navigation, forms, loading/error states, accessibility behavior or browser state.

expand.when: A mutation or expected-revision flow changes.
SSE, invalidations or reconnect behavior changes.
API request/response shapes change.
Sign-in, sessions, access loss or directory selection changes.
Shared presets or dashboards change.

checks: Run relevant frontend README type/build and browser workflows; distinguish controlled API fixtures from real integrated behavior.

routes.title: Native and Kafka event contracts
when: Changing native input or Kafka event fields, semantics, serialization or compatibility.

expand.when: A shared package or generated client pin changes.
Replay, order, cutover or deployed consumer compatibility changes.
Stored proof or data structures change.

checks: Read contracts and producer/consumer READMEs; regenerate with existing tools, run drift/compatibility and affected consumer checks, and identify actual producer revisions.

routes.title: HTTP contracts and generated clients
when: Changing Product API or Ingestion API endpoints, request/response envelopes, or generated client types.

expand.when: The API is native/Grafana admission or changes an event field.
Mutation semantics, expected revisions or retry receipts change.
Published package pins or consumer dependencies change.
The resource is incident content or lifecycle.
The resource is a shared preset or dashboard.

checks: Read producer, contracts and frontend READMEs; generate schemas/types using repository tools and run drift plus affected producer/consumer compatibility checks.

routes.title: PostgreSQL schema, privileges and migrations
when: Changing tables, columns, indexes, RLS, SQL privileges or migration execution.

expand.when: Changed data belongs to incidents; inspect its readers and writers.
Deployment ordering, stopped writers or adoption/cutover changes.
Tenant or authorization boundaries change.
Recovery or protected proof changes.

checks: Follow migrations README for checksum/history integrity, supported upgrades, schema/privilege checks and affected writers using isolated PostgreSQL.

routes.title: Identity, sessions, grants and authorization
when: Changing authentication, tenant access, grants, identity publication or assignee eligibility.

expand.when: Grant/tenant commands change.
Sessions or access revocation affect SSE streams.
Stored identity/audit records or privileges change.
Identity recovery or publication proof changes.

checks: Read API/domain/delivery guidance; test current grants, known revocations, trusted publication, expiry, tenant isolation and restore gates.

routes.title: Live publishing, SSE and reconciliation
when: Changing API live publishing, SSE streams, reconnect, polling, scoped invalidation or render proof.

expand.when: Session or tenant authorization changes.
Alert searchable progress is part of refresh.
Outbox permissions or schema changes.
Deployment capacity or old live-worker shutdown is affected.

checks: Use API/frontend checks for lost/duplicate hints, connected-tenant reconciliation, reconnect, access loss, shutdown and visible freshness.

routes.title: Alert CEL, search projection and visibility
when: Changing CEL semantics, alert search/counts, Elasticsearch projection, reconciliation or rebuild.

expand.when: Shared field definitions or event formats change.
Correlation CEL eligibility changes.
Browser refresh or relative-time behavior changes.
Rebuild or index-switch rollout changes.
Preset/dashboard query or count semantics change.

checks: Follow indexer/domain/API test guidance; serialize native CEL suites, verify exact counts, tenant isolation, ordering, missed-hint reconciliation and rebuild proof.

routes.title: Deployment, qualification and coordinated rollout
when: Preparing a release, changing workloads or assessing capability readiness and rollout compatibility.

expand.when: Packages, locks or pinned source revisions change.
Migration, privilege or writer ordering changes.
Restore/drain/cutover proof changes.
A missing capability depends on identity.

checks: Read current delivery README/runbooks and manifest; record revisions, dirty state, images, migrations, configuration and executed evidence. Deployment authorization remains separate.

routes.title: Packages, locks and workspace compatibility
when: Changing packages, lock files, internal revision pins or coordinated editable environments.

expand.when: Package behavior or cross-repository runtime contracts change.
HTTP request/response schemas or generated client types change.
Native input or Kafka event contracts change.
A release combination or rollout is being qualified.

checks: Inspect affected manifests, locks and READMEs; record actual source revisions and local overrides, validate Poetry locks and run the affected consumer checks.

routes.title: Documentation and instruction maintenance
when: Changing instructions, navigation, task routes, document links or explanatory prose without changing product requirements.

expand.when: A specification or design decision changes product behavior.
Repository ownership or package boundaries change.
Operational guidance or release evidence changes.

checks: Use design README/check_docs and delivery documentation/context checks; preserve all 55 issue IDs and decision numbering, and synchronize canonical/installed instructions when affected.

routes.title: Alert lifecycle and manual operations
when: Changing alert assignment, notes, lifecycle, suppression controls, history or bulk manual operations.

expand.when: Manual mutation commands change.
Maintenance suppression or qualifying transitions change.
Incident ownership changes.
Native input or source event semantics change.
History/replay protection or cleanup changes.
Current search/count behavior changes.

checks: Follow API/domain/processor guidance for source/manual ordering, derived status, actor/history proof, no-op commands and tenant isolation.

routes.title: Operator keys, Kong and Grafana provisioning
when: Changing operator lifecycle, keys, synchronous provisioning or shared Grafana routing.

expand.when: Native/Grafana input or event mapping changes.
Kong plugin migration or deployed binding changes.
Credential recovery, revocation or replay fences change.

checks: Use API/ingestion test guidance for partial remote operations, explicit retry, generation/all-node proof, exact routing labels, secret disposal and denial barriers.

routes.title: Shared presets and dashboards
when: Changing saved presets, dashboard definitions, count batches, shared editing or references.

expand.when: CEL, search/count or caching semantics change.
Saved editing commands or conflict handling change.
Rendering or browser interaction changes.
References, indexes or stored layout schema change.
Refresh, invalidation or visibility changes.

checks: Use API/frontend checks for exact count provenance, references, concurrent saves, responsive layout and saved/shared behavior; personal views remain excluded.

routes.title: Recovery fences, replay and retained history
when: Changing restore safety, retirement helpers, protected proof, replay fences or history access.

expand.when: Schema, privileges or migration proof changes.
Source transport, replay or cutover changes.
Release recovery qualification or supplied capability changes.
Retained incident lifecycle or references change.

checks: Follow delivery recovery runbooks and owning-repository checks; preserve read-time windows and retirement/revocation fences while automation remains deferred.
